_meta.title: Directory / file on an SSH host
_meta.setup: Add the host under SSH first (or put the service into a system with an SSH host). path = absolute directory or file on that host.

description: Directory on a host, e.g. a local repository or config folder
examples: svc files NAME pull && svc files NAME diff
notes: sudo: true uses the host's sudo prefix (for files the SSH user can't read).
